svg.title: One purchase through near-preflight
svg.desc: Inside the near-preflight frame: the guard contract on NEAR testnet, the off-chain sentinel and its proof file, which anyone can replay. Outside it: the AI agent, NEAR Chain Signatures, a relay with no key, and Base. 1: the agent asks the guard to check a token and an amount. 2: the sentinel reads the check and simulates on Base the buy the guard would sign, then its resales. 3: it stores the verdict on the guard with the sha256 of its evidence. 4: on a fresh allow, the agent buys, naming no route or recipient. 5: the guard builds the simulated swap and Chain Signatures signs it. 6: a relay with no key broadcasts it, in the demo to a local fork of Base.
